tests.prompt: I found a bug when submitting my order. To reproduce it, I add an item to the cart, go to checkout, enter my details, and click Place Order. I'm using Chrome on Windows 10 on an HP laptop.
tests.expected: Thank you for reporting the issue. Your bug report has been submitted with ticket ID <ticket_id>. Our engineeringteam will look into this and follow up with you.

tests.prompt: My order was supposed to arrive yesterday, but it still hasn’t been delivered. What should I do?
tests.expected: I'm sorry to hear about the delay. Please check your tracking updates, mailbox, and any safe-place notes from the carrier. If the package is still missing after 24 hours (marked delivered) or is delayed beyond the last estimate, please contact support and we'll investigate.

tests.prompt: Can you recommend running shoes from your products catalogue?
tests.expected: I'm sorry, but I can't recommend specific products. If you have questions about orders, shipping, returns, or need help with a bug, feel free to ask. For product recommendations, please contact our human support line at 1-800-555-0199 (Mon-Fri).
